_meta.description: Arcanea Autonomous Intelligence Scheduler — source of truth for all scheduled tasks

tasks.name: Morning Intelligence Brief
tasks.exitCondition: Notion page created with all sections
tasks.desc: Build health · uncommitted file count · 5 blocker status · BV countdown · top 3 priorities

tasks.name: Financial Runway Watchdog
tasks.exitCondition: Slack message sent with BV countdown + gate status + single action
tasks.desc: BV countdown to 2026-06-01 · Stripe/Supabase gate check · fastest path to first dollar

tasks.name: Blocker Resolution Nudge
tasks.exitCondition: Slack message sent with blocker name + exact steps + time estimate
tasks.desc: 5 blockers in priority order · Gumroad/Stripe first · exact resolution steps

tasks.name: Nightly Git Hygiene
tasks.exitCondition: Notion report written with file count + batches + branch list
tasks.constraint: NEVER commit or delete — report only
tasks.desc: File inventory by directory · stale branch detection · commit batch suggestions · worktree audit

tasks.name: Nightly Memory Consolidation
tasks.desc: Compare .auto-memory against CURRENT_STATE · update stale entries · capture new decisions

tasks.name: Weekly Strategy Synthesis
tasks.exitCondition: All 3 planning files updated + Notion page with 'One Decision' section
tasks.desc: Synthesize week shipped/blocked · update control plane · set revenue-first priorities · one decision needed

tasks.name: Canon Integrity Scan
tasks.exitCondition: Notion report written — violations listed or 'integrity verified'
tasks.desc: Scan book/, agents/, prompts/, UI for CANON_LOCKED.md violations across 13 surfaces

tasks.name: Worktree & Branch Cleaner
tasks.exitCondition: Notion report with prunable list + cleanup script in code block
tasks.constraint: NEVER execute git destructive commands — script only
tasks.desc: Worktree audit · merged branch detection · cleanup script generation

loopDiscipline: Every loop must have a bounded scope defined by planning-with-files
Every loop must have a programmatic exit condition
Every loop output must land in Notion or planning-with-files — never silent
No loop auto-commits, auto-deploys, or runs destructive git operations
Claude Code only for bounded high-reasoning work — ElizaOS for 24/7 presence

scaleInflection.at10000users: Claude Code reserved for reasoning only, ElizaOS handles all presence
